recognize_zh: 這是低倍的骨髓抹片：背景為大量散在的有核細胞與紅血球，右側有一大團緊密聚集的深藍色細胞團（骨髓小粒/細胞聚集），另見少數較大的單顆細胞（可能為巨核細胞或組織球）；此倍率無法確認噬血現象，需高倍檢視骨髓小粒周邊的組織球。
features: Low-power view of an aspirate smear with a dense, darkly staining cellular aggregate/particle at right
Smaller cellular cluster near the top edge of the smear
Scattered larger single cells (possible megakaryocytes or histiocytes) in the cellular trails
Diffuse background of nucleated cells and red cells
Hemophagocytic histiocytes cannot be resolved at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power examination of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with a dense aggregate of hematopoietic cells and a smaller cluster near the feathered edge, along with scattered larger single cells in the cellular trails. Individual cell morphology, including the presence of phagocytosed blood cells within histiocytes, cannot be assessed at this magnification. The image is useful to locate particles and cellular areas where high-power search for hemophagocytic histiocytes should be performed. Diagnosis of hemophagocytic syndrome requires high-power confirmation and correlation with clinical and laboratory HLH criteria.

ddx.vs: Tumor clusters are cohesive with large cells and molding at high power, which cannot be excluded at this magnification and requires closer examination.
Clotted areas contain fibrin and platelet clumps and distort cells, whereas intact particles show preserved stroma and fat with hematopoietic cells.
